li.label: sat with them while there was time
li.description: They haven't long now. I sat with them a while and we talked, and I'm glad I did it while I could.

li.label: not alone at the end
li.description: They came and sat with me. Whatever comes, I won't face it alone.

li.label: one of us moved on
li.description: We walked them to the gate and waved until the road bent. They went with our blessing, and their place at the table is still empty.

li.label: stayed instead of going to family
li.description: I asked to go to my family, and the council asked me to stay. I'm needed here, I know. I still think about them every day.

li.label: my love is staying
li.description: They said yes. No more waiting for the next visit: they live here now, with me.

li.label: apart again
li.description: Nothing changes. They'll go home when the visit's over, and I'll wait for the next one, the way I always do.

li.label: promised a room of my own
li.description: The council promised me a room of my own. I'll believe it when I sleep in it, but it's something.

li.label: told to make do
li.description: I asked for a room or leave to go, and the council told me to make do. So I'm making do.

li.label: kept from my family
li.description: I asked to go to my family, and I stayed. I think about them more than I say.

li.label: longing for my family
li.description: Every day I stay is a day I'm not with them. I don't know how many more there will be.

li.label: aching to go to my family
li.description: I stay because the council asked. My family is out there without me, and it's eating at me.

li.label: living apart from my love
li.description: We live apart, and that's how it stays. I count the days to the next visit.

li.label: missing my love
li.description: Every goodbye is harder than the one before. This was never meant to be for good.

li.label: heartsick for my love
li.description: The one I love is out there and I'm here, because the council said so. I can't go on like this much longer.

li.label: waiting for a room of my own
li.description: I was told there would be a room for me. I'm still sleeping among everyone else.

li.label: no room of my own
li.description: I asked for a corner to myself and got told to make do. I'm making do, and I'm sick of it.

li.label: worn thin without a room
li.description: Never a door to close, never a night alone. I stayed because the council asked, and I regret it.

li.label: asked twice, kept twice
li.description: I came to the council a second time, and a second time they said no. I'll stay. I won't forget it.

li.label: my family came to live here
li.description: I didn't have to choose after all. They came here, to me, and they're staying.

li.label: the council kept its word
li.description: They promised me a room of my own, and here it is. A door that closes, and a bed nobody else sleeps in.

li.label: a room of my own at last
li.description: After all that making do, a room of my own. It took long enough.

li.label: gave up my room
li.description: The council asked me to give up my room so someone else wouldn't leave. I said yes. I miss my door.
